title: Prakas on Requirements and Procedures of Registration of Competition of Business Combinations subject to Pre-Notification
text:
Unofficial Translation
Kingdom of Cambodia
Nation Religion King
Ministry of Commerce
No. 177 P.N.A.KBB.PRK
Prakas
On
Requirements and Procedures of Registration of Completion of Business Combinations subject to
Pre-Notification
Minister of Commerce
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0918/925 dated 6 September 2018 on the Appointment of
the Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/0320/421 dated 30 March 2020 on the Appointment and
Adjustment of the Composition of the Royal Government of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0618/012 dated 28 June 2018 promulgating the Law on
the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/16 dated 24 January 1996 promulgating the Law on
the Establishment Ministry of Commerce;
- Having seen the Royal Decree No. NS/RKT/1021/013 dated 05 October 2021 promulgating of the Law
on Competition;
- Having seen Sub-Decree No. 38 ANKR.BK dated 16 March 2020 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Ministry of Commerce;
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 37 ANKR.BK dated 17 February 2022 on the Organization and
Functioning of the Cambodia Competition Commission;
- Having seen the Sub-Decree No. 60 ANKR.BK dated 6 March 2023 on the Requirements and
Procedures for Business Combinations; and
- According to the necessity of the Ministry of Commerce.
1/3

Unofficial Translation
Hereby Decides
Article 1.-
This Prakas sets out the requirements and procedures for registration of completion of Business
Combinations subject to Pre-Notification for the purpose of granting the Business Combination
acknowledgment and legitimacy.
Article 2.-
This Prakas applies to any Business Combination that is subject to Pre-Notification and required
to register its status pursuant to Article 12 of Sub-Decree No. 60 ANKR.BK dated 6 March 2023 on
Requirements and Procedures for Business Combinations.
Article 3.-
One of the Notifying Parties of the Business Combination as stipulated in Article 12 of the Sub-
Decree on Requirements and Procedures for Business Combinations shall submit a registration form
within 30 (thirty) working days after substantive completion of the Business Combination to the
Cambodia Competition Commission (“CCC”) in accordance with the requirements set forth in the
registration form (as attached in the annex of this Prakas).
The CCC may amend the registration form as attached in the annex of this Prakas if necessary.
The Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General (“CCF”), the
secretariat of the CCC, is appointed to receive registration forms for Business Combinations.
Article 4.-
The parties proposing to undertake a Business Combination shall submit the following documents
and information:
a) a registration form for Business Combinations;
b) a copy of the certificate of tax compliance from the General Department of Taxation of the
Ministry of Economic and Finance;
c) a copy of the business registration and any documents pertaining to alienation from Ministry
of Commerce and relevant ministries and institutions;
d) a copy of documents from relevant sectoral regulators ministries, and institutions pertaining
to the request for Business Combinations (if applicable);
e) a copy of the proof confirming the CCC's approval of the Business Combination; and
f) a copy of the receipt of the registration for Business Combinations.
Article 5.-
Within 7 (seven) working days of receipt of the registration form for Business Combinations as
stipulated in Article 4 of this Prakas, CCF Directorate-General shall issue a notice to the parties proposing
to undertake a Business Combinations confirming fulfillment of the obligation to register the Business
Combination under Article 12 of the Sub-Decree on Requirements and Procedures for Business
Combinations or identify any defect or omission in the submitted documents and information to the CCC.
2/3

Unofficial Translation
Upon receiving notice from the CCF Directorate-General concerning any defect or omission in
the submitted documents and information to the CCC, the parties proposing to undertake a Business
Combination shall submit additional documents and information that prove the documents
and information submitted to the CCC were not materially defective or omitted within 15 (fifteen)
working days. If the party proposing to undertake a Business Combination fails to provide the required
documents and information within the specified timeframe, the registration for Business Combination is
deemed to be void. In this case, the parties proposing to undertake a Business Combination shall propose
to the CCC again to undertake the Business Combination.
The CCF Directorate-General may extend the timeframe for providing additional documents and
information set forth in the second paragraph above, on the request of the parties proposing to undertake
a Business Combination and if there is a reasonable ground.
Article 6.-
Any provisions contrary to this Prakas shall be abrogated.
Article 7.-
Members of the CCC, Director of the Cabinet, Delegate of the Royal Government in charge as
Director-General of the Consumer Protection Competition and Fraud Repression Directorate-General,
and Heads of all relevant authorities shall be responsible for the implementation of this Prakas in
accordance with their respective duties from the date of signature.
[Buddhist Date]
Done in Phnom Penh, 14th June 2023
Minister of Commerce
and Chairman of the Cambodia Competition Commission
[seal and signature]
Pan Sorasak
Recipients:
- Council of Ministers
- Cabinet of Samdech Akka Moha Sena Padei Techo Prime Minister
- Cabinet of Samdech, His Excellency Deputy Prime Ministers
- Municipal and Provincial Administrations
- As stated in Article 7
- Royal Gazette
- Documentation and Archive
